source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to stereoisomerism in complexes (PDF 31).

blocks.text: Stereoisomers ka kimiyai formula aur bonds aik jaise hote hain lekin ligands ki khala (space) mein tarteeb mukhtalif hoti hai. Complexes do qism ki stereoisomerism dikhate hain: geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism aur optical isomerism.

blocks.prompt: Complexes ki dikhai jane wali stereoisomerism ki do qismein batayein.

items: Stereoisomers: formula aur bonds wahi, khala mein tarteeb mukhtalif.
